get_alibi_bias: generate an ALiBi positional bias tensor for a given number of attention heads and max sequence positions
get_alibi_slopes: compute ALiBi slope values for attention heads using power-of-2 interpolation for non-power-of-2 head counts
masked_alibi_filter: apply a mask to an ALiBi bias tensor to filter out padded positions in batched sequences
review_get_alibi: review the get_alibi function and its symmetric non-autoregressive positional bias design for wav2vec2 models
test_masked_alibi: test the masked_alibi function to verify correct reshaping and masking of ALiBi bias tensors
